title: SQL 窗口函数 (Window Functions)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (12/16)：ROW_NUMBER、RANK、DENSE_RANK、SUM/AVG OVER、LAG、LEAD 与 NTILE

content.tips: orders 取 user_id、amount，再用 ROW_NUMBER 按 user_id 分区、amount 降序编号，别名 rn
content.content: SELECT user_id, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn FROM orders;

content.tips: exams 取 name、score，再用 RANK 按 score 降序排名，别名 rk
content.content: SELECT name, score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk FROM exams;

content.tips: exams 取 name、score，再用 DENSE_RANK 按 score 降序排名，别名 rk
content.content: SELECT name, score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk FROM exams;

content.tips: products 每个 category 取 price 最高的前 3：子查询用 ROW_NUMBER 别名 rn，外层表别名 t 筛 t.rn 不大于 3
content.content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn FROM products) t WHERE t.rn <= 3;

content.tips: orders 取 id、amount，再用 SUM OVER 按 id 排序累计求和，别名 running_total
content.content: SELECT id, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS running_total FROM orders;

content.tips: orders 取 id、amount，再用 AVG OVER 按 id 排序取前 2 行到当前行的移动平均，别名 ma3
content.content: SELECT id, amount, AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma3 FROM orders;

content.tips: orders 取 id、amount，再用 LAG 按 id 排序取上 1 行的 amount，别名 prev_amount
content.content: SELECT id, amount, LAG(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS prev_amount FROM orders;

content.tips: orders 取 id、amount，再用 LEAD 按 id 排序取下 1 行的 amount，别名 next_amount
content.content: SELECT id, amount, LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS next_amount FROM orders;

content.tips: exams 取 name、score，再用 NTILE 按 score 降序分成 4 桶，别名 quartile
content.content: SELECT name, score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS quartile FROM exams;
